newsitem.title: UK: UK orders forces food supplies from Booker.
newsitem.headline: UK orders forces food supplies from Booker.

text.p: Britain's Defence Minstry said on Tuesday it was placing a five-year contract worth more than 400 million stg to purchase, warehouse and distribute food supplies for the armed forces in Britain and Germany with Booker Foodservice Group, part of Booker Plc.

A ministry statement quoted minister Nicholas Soames as saying that the decision has been taken after an evaluation of tenders received that judged Booker "to offer the best overall value for money for the Department".
The contract will also involve "meeting the needs of ships, exercises and operations worldwide", the MoD added.
At present supplies are handled by the Navy, Army and Air Force Institutes, known as the NAAFI, under a three-year contract that expires on September 30 this year.
The ministry said the NAAFI would continue to provide its traditional range of retail and other services to the forces.
